info.title: Mustang working areas
instructions: Area 6 is not normally used unless Corpus Approach can support traffic advisories for Seagull course rules traffic
info.source: Binder, p. 19; Feb 2026 PPT, Part 1, slide 76.

info.title: Stay 3 NM clear of KRAS
instructions: Maintain a 3 NM stand-off from Mustang Beach Airport when para-jumping is in effect
Confirm with ATC that para-jumping is not in effect before working within 3 NM
The stand-off applies to working altitudes below 11,500 ft MSL
info.source: Binder, p. 19; Feb 2026 PPT, Part 1, slide 75.

info.title: No aerobatics west of the beach line
instructions: Aerobatics, spins and stalls are prohibited west of the beach line
Federal Airway V-13-20-163: no aerobatic flight within 4 NM of the centerline (FAR 91.303)
info.source: Binder, p. 19; Feb 2026 PPT, Part 1, slide 75.
